statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOURNING THE LOSS OF WALTON COUNTY'S SHERIFF DEPUTY WILLIAM "WILL" PAUL THOMAS MAY
statements.title: MOURNING THE LOSS OF WALTON COUNTY'S SHERIFF DEPUTY WILLIAM "WILL" PAUL THOMAS MAY
sentences: Deputy May's courageous actions underscore the dangers that law enforcement faces every day while protecting our communities.
Deputy May went above and beyond during his 11-year career in law enforcement.
On top of his impressive law enforcement career, he was a dedicated husband to his wife, Crystal, and an exemplary father to his four children: Zane, Clarice, Layla, and Tracker.

May his sacrifice serve as a reminder that this body must always support our law enforcement and ensure that they have all the support necessary to safely protect our communities. ____________________
